text: CLI in Python implemented as single file time_tracker.py
Subcommand 'start <project>' starts a session for a project
Subcommand 'report' shows total time per project
Sessions persisted in a JSON file across invocations
Refuse to start a session while another is active (error, nonzero exit, state unchanged)
Detect overlapping sessions (e.g. in stored data)
Report aggregates total time correctly per project across multiple sessions
Implied: stop with no active session gives an error rather than crashing/silently succeeding
Implied: missing/invalid arguments handled with usage error (e.g. start without project)
Implied: corrupt/missing JSON file handled gracefully
